E4Plus1.uk.description: G.I. (Annoyed Grunt): Homer accidentally signs up for basic training in the army. And Marge and Grampa get roped in when they try to get him released. (S18 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Moe 'n' a Lisa: Lisa discovers Moe's poetic talent and helps get him published. And he's so successful that he - and the Simpsons - are invited to a literary conference. (S18 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fizbo: Phil and Claire throw Luke the biggest birthday party a boy could want. But when Cameron appears as a clown named Fizbo, it sets off a chain of events that ends in hospital. (S1 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Undeck the Halls: Christmas is in full swing at the Dunphy house, until the kids get into trouble and Phil and Claire threaten to cancel Christmas unless one of them fesses up. (S1 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: After weeks of honeymoons filled with love, laughter and tonnes of tiffs, the couples return to face their first major test: the first dinner party. (S13 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Coach Trip
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Lisbon, some loved-up newbies join the trip, while one celeb is missing, and the rivalry heats up in bubble football. Who'll be shown the red card at the vote? (S4 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rome-Old & Juli-eh: Homer stops paying for Grampa's retirement home, so he has to stay with the family instead. In a twist no one saw coming, Grampa ends up marrying Selma. (S18 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homerazzi: Homer becomes a paparazzo to get money to pay for fire damage to the house. But Springfield's celebrities are alarmed by his aggressive style and fight back. (S18 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: A revelation leaves Warren seething, and tensions flare at The Loft. Meanwhile, when a text lands in the wrong hands, a resident is forced into a tough parenting dilemma.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Australia - Brand new series: The newly-weds move in together and face tasks designed to make them more honest with each other. But honesty isn't always the best policy... (S13 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box this time: Casualty, Queer Eye, Below Deck Sailing Yacht, FUBAR, Open House: The Great Sex Experiment, Big Beasts and BBC News (Phillip Schofield). (S21 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers have been watching: Sitting on a Fortune, Casualty, Britain's Got Talent, MerPeople, James May: Oh Cook!, The Greatest Auction and Top of the Pops 1994. (S21 Ep15)
